method: Geometric mean across condition medians of seven paired candidate/control or candidate/Expat worker-median elapsed ratios. Smaller is better. Native/Python and normal/PGO are separate campaigns.

archive.scope: Deterministic producer packaging and complete streaming readback; independent benchmark audits are separate. No executable target or historical nested archive included.
excluded: Parser libraries, static archives, native driver binary, Python interpreter and all compiled consumer extensions; these remain identified by recorded path/hash and origin receipts.
Target/build caches, profile data, nested historical archives, full CPython trees and unrelated study outputs.
Strict cleanup-patched consumer timings: benchmark consumer source is unmodified CPython3.12.13.

python_consumer_scope: Unmodified CPython3.12.13 pyexpat.c fd679a16 and _elementtree.c de4c3c87; the cleanup-patched strict CPython gate is separate.
preparation_failure: Original normal preparation compiled consumers successfully then CPU3 preflight failed the old CPU4 guard before parser execution. Original failure retained. Attempt02 changed preparation guard to CPU3 and retained all fixture/assertion/timing bounds. OriginalPGO sibling was prepared but not executed.
interpretation: The policy removes arbitrary lifetime-stream rejection while native and actualPython real-project timings remain close to the preceding accepted control. The fixed PGO aggregate remains slower than Expat:1.37540x native and1.13775x actualPython. This does not meet the faster-than-Expat objective. Generated controls and every per-condition regression remain recorded.

source_origins.scope: All original benchmark input paths map to archived identical bytes or explicit excluded ELF binaries; includes alternate corpus checkout paths.
